seats.name: daveey
seats.notes: the farm pole: four gardeners, a hex flower each, every       neutral tree shaken and every robot-bearing one chopped open, and the       surplus above a hundred and fifty bullets spent on points the moment it       appears

seats.name: daveey-1
seats.notes: the swarm pole: two gardeners, a ring that keeps the spawn       lane open, half its army money on lumberjacks and a fifth       on tanks, nothing held back and nothing donated -- their farm dies or mine does
